purpose: This table holds hourly ASOS weather observations at the three NYC airport weather stations (EWR, JFK, LGA) for January through June 2013, cleaned for use alongside the flights dataset's origin column.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour (or on origin, year, month, day, hour) to attach weather conditions to flight records; consumers aggregating wind or pressure metrics must explicitly handle nulls in wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust, and pressure rather than assuming complete coverage.
limitations: wind_gust is missing in 74.6% of rows and pressure in 11.5% of rows; wind_dir and wind_speed have small but nonzero null rates (1.68% and 0.015% respectively); none of these were imputed, and no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no row-level deduplication was applied.
